next_step_recommendation: Do a research-ideation iteration next. Choose between 257c (multi-sample scenario objective) and 258a (richer latent prior in token space).
current_best_model: Frontier remains at 4/11 across prior families; use the most informative current baseline for the next iteration rather than assuming a single winner.
